description: Semantic versions: parse, compare, sort, and check against npm-style ranges. Parses SemVer 2.0 versions; compares two (a vs b); sorts a list (invalid ones reported); checks versions against npm range syntax (^, ~, x-ranges, hyphen ranges, comparators, ||) with correct prerelease rules; returns the highest version satisfying the range. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
